sql:
SELECT
  stores_source_src_10000.region AS store__region
  , SUM(subq_3.__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    store_id AS store
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_source_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_3
LEFT OUTER JOIN
  "data"."main"."stores" stores_source_src_10000
ON
  subq_3.store = stores_source_src_10000.store_id
GROUP BY
  stores_source_src_10000.region
